snippet.textDisplay:
I know it’s been a while since Bieber’s Coachella performance went viral, but hear me out. Some called it iconic, while others thought it was too simple and undeserving of the hype. But honestly, I REALLY, REALLY loved it!

And can we talk about the idea behind it? He used the platform itself and, as some have pointed out, possibly avoided issues with his old songs by turning his performance into a karaoke-style throwback. But beyond that, he brought us back to where it all began.

People are calling it iconic and brilliant, and YES, IT IS! But are we forgetting something? YOUTUBE. THE VERY PLATFORM WHERE JUSTIN BIEBER FIRST ROSE TO FAME. HE WAS A YOUTUBE SENSATION, Y’ALL! The nostalgia, the full-circle moment? THAT’S what made it so brilliant. 💜
. 💜

snippet.textDisplay:
Hi Katy , I live in France and I am a 29-year-old . I came to see you in Luxembourg on July 14 on the stage of the Luxexpo Open Air . I enjoyed your concert and had a great time, and I was very happy to have seen you for the first time in my life ... You hadn’t done it since 2009, let’s hope you’ll come back soon to this place and that the next time won’t be in 17 years ... If during your next visit to Luxembourg or France , we could meet, take a photo together, or if you could sign an autograph for me , I would be very delighted and very happy . I enjoyed your foam throwing at the end, your bottle raised above the crowd, it allowed me to film you and see you up close, as well as your performance on the white acoustic guitar !!!!! We love you in France , you are in our hearts and Thank you very much for your visit to France and Luxembourg and for everything too ... I wish you lots of happiness and the best as well , Take care of yourself and see you very soon , I hope ...
A French Spectator .

snippet.textDisplay:
Receta de Pastel de Choclo
Preparación
Para el pino, en un sartén cocinar la cebolla en aceite hasta que cristalice. Agregar ajo, agua, la carne, ají de color, orégano, aliño completo, sal y pimienta a gusto.
Para el armado, poner el pino en recipientes de greda y rellenar con huevo cocido, aceitunas, pasas y pollo. Reservar.
Para la pastelera, cocinar todos los ingredientes juntos hasta que esté lista.
Vaciar la pastelera en los recipientes de greda.
Agregar azúcar y cubitos de Mantequilla sin Sal Soprole en la superficie y llevar a un horno precalentado por 20 a 30 minutos hasta que dore.
Servir tibio

snippet.textDisplay:
cazuela de vacuno

Ingredientes

1 cda de aceite

1 kg de asado de tira o tapapecho

1/2 pimentón (cortado en tiras)

2 dientes de ajo

1 zanahoria (cortada en tiras)

1 ramita de apio

6 papas

1 tz de porotos verdes

6 trozos de zapallo

3 cdas de arroz

6 trozos de choclo

Perejil picado

1 1/2 l de agua fría

1 cda de Orégano Entero Gourmet

Sal de Mar, Ajo y Perejil Gourmet a gusto

Pimienta Blanca Molida Gourmet (en pequeña cantidad)

Aliño Completo Gourmet

Sal de Mar Gourmet

Preparación

Corta la carne en 6 trozos.

En una olla grande, calienta el aceite y sella la carne por ambos lados. Condimenta con sal de mar, ajo y perejil.

Agrega el agua fría, el pimentón, los dientes de ajo, la zanahoria y la rama de apio. Cocina a fuego medio durante 20 a 25 minutos si es en olla a presión o por 35 a 40 minutos si es en olla tradicional.

Mientras tanto, pela las papas.

Cuando la carne esté blanda, añade las papas, el zapallo y el arroz, y cocina con la olla destapada.

Cuando las papas estén casi listas, incorpora los choclos y los porotos verdes.

Condimenta con aliño completo, orégano entero, pimienta blanca molida y sal de mar, ajo y perejil a gusto.

Cocina a fuego bajo, con la olla tapada, hasta que los choclos estén bien cocidos.

Sirve caliente y espolvorea perejil picado.

snippet.textDisplay:
I loved this performance because it truly represented so many parts of the United States. The drums, flags, ball and energy with IShowSpeed showed the real spirit of football. Madonna represented American pop culture, while the Muppets and Cookie Monster brought back the childhood icons so many of us grew up with. The orchestra added elegance, BTS represented the international side of the World Cup, Justin Bieber brought a beautiful emotional and spiritual moment, and Post Malone represented another side of American music.

One of the most beautiful moments was Coldplay singing about love surrounded by all those children. That is exactly what football is about: young people, often from humble beginnings, believing they can make their dreams happen and one day become the players and idols the world admires.

Then Shakira closed it as the international icon she is. The world was watching, and although the United States has never been known as a football country, I believe that after this World Cup, we will be.

It still feels so unreal that we have to celebrate your birthday without you.
With your voice, your smile, and the person you were, you touched so many people all around the world. Even though you are no longer here, you are not forgotten. Your music, your memories, and all the beautiful moments you gave us will stay with us forever.
We miss you. More than words can sometimes say.
And even though time keeps moving forward, you will always be a part of us.
Forever a Directioner.
Forever Liam.
Forever in our hearts.
Happy 33rd Birthday, Liam.
I hope you're celebrating beautifully up there.
Today, and every other day, we are thinking of you.
We will never forget you.
Forever.🕊️❤️

snippet.textDisplay: The final post & final video that they left us. What a time and era that this brings me back into. Now even hitting even harder knowing that Liam has passed, all that has happened to him, all that has been announced, all that has been said about him, and now offically an end of an era of them possibly reuniting along with a piece of our childhood gone. An icon and legend of our childhood. Back when everything was so simple. Time passes by so fast & the countless memories of childhood nostalgia always hits. Now most of us true fans are in our 20s with newer people only finding out about Liam & One Direction now from when watched & listened to them during our childhood now that Liam has passed. Rest in Peace Liam. You'll always be in our hearts. Thank you so much for the huge impact and influence you've had on us, on world & especially during our childhood along with the rest of One Direction. Thank you so much once again Liam. Even if you werent a fan of One Direction or of Liam, nobody can deny the impact & influence they had on the world during that time they were altogether. They were everywhere, on the raido, TV - literally everywhere. Man time was so simple back then, social media barely even existed, phones werent such a thing, and barely existed during our childhood & we would entertain oursleves by listening & watching them. They were so popular at the time & now here we all are as adults, reunited paying our respects to Liam with childhood nostalgia hitting us even harder, now that he passed.  🖤🙏🙏🙏

snippet.textDisplay: Our family is so thankful for Charlie's music and for him sharing his gift of perfect pitch with the world! My son Eugene is 8 years old and also has perfect pitch, but it’s not all butterflies and rainbows. Sounds were often overwhelming for him in his younger years, and as a result, he was frequently misunderstood by teachers and peers - and I found myself stepping in countless times to advocate for my son. I’m happy to share that my son is beginning to better harness this ability, and I’m doing my best as his parent to nurture his gift (WE LOVE MUSIC)! Thanks to Charlie being so open about how it affects him socially (especially in his interview with Jimmy Fallon), it truly helps parents of children with perfect pitch, like me, better understand what they’re going through so we can nurture their gift properly. We’re also starting to see more kids on YouTube with perfect pitch who are thriving, which makes us feel less alone, more seen, and understood - and I truly believe this is all thanks to Charlie creating awareness about it. It is such a fascinating ability - some people even see COLOR when they hear sounds (synesthesia). It goes without saying that we are HUGE fans of Charlie Puth, and we can’t wait to see him LIVE IN CONCERT very soon! Eugene had so much fun playing piano and rearranging “Beat Yourself Up” in G-flat major, "Changes" in F major, analyzing and recreating his Vocal Harmony Challenge and he’s learning tons of music theory and production tips from Charlie’s “Professor Puth” series as well. ✨Thank you, Charlie, for also inspiring this Mama Bear to sing more. Let’s all continue learning and jammin’ together!

snippet.textDisplay: Okay, no one else other than a fellow guitarist will notice this, but that white Stratocaster is something VERY special.  It's called a James Tyler guitar and it's over $2,000. What makes it so special? Well, considering every great 80's guitarist has/had one and it's an essential part of that signature 80's compress chorus sound everyone loves so much, yeah. That's AUTHENTIC 80's equipment right there. And I'm EXTREMELY jealous of Charlie's guitarist for owning one. Just look up Dann Huff. He has a signature model Tyler guitar and look at the number of songs you know that he was the guitarist on and you'll see exactly what I mean.

Classic song through and through.

I have no friends I see anymore. All live far away

I want to provide a place for them in real life but in reality these worries apply just as much to myself. I escape the fear by applying it to another and wishing to be a hero in the situation.

Mind you we can't be traditional friends but these people mean the world to me ❤

snippet.textDisplay:
Explanation:

first thing I noticed was ye drawing the swords: 2 of swords in tarot, it represents a difficult choice, a stalemate, or a conscious block against an inevitable decision.
the swords mean they are ready for battle (spiritual and earthly warfare)
The jezebel is opposite the man praying showing an opposition of worldly and spiritual values.

What's inside ye:
the doctors (society/media) are playing with the apples (the of parts of him they CAN take.)
the birds fly above the jezebel, (she's for the birds? lol)
the butterflies show that what's inside of him is beautiful
the 7 stars inside him for holiness
the bible and candles were taken from him and a doctor is converted by what's inside him (still won't be saved)
the unpotted flower: to show how rebirth can be sometimes unorthodox, its on fire but unburned- undying through what's meant to harm it
They can't take his heart.
the balloon is silver like the silver cord cord that some say ties the soul to the body- he's ascended
Don Oliver is the people that won't stand by and watch the doctors play with ye
-
the jezebel hangs up the phone when ye gets his head back! its over for the worldly pleasures as the doctors (society/media) are cut down.
at the end his eyes are empty but focused on the viewer ( a 4th wall break) because he's completely conscious but still undead (hurt by what happened)
lambs represent sacrifice and purity (in the end he's still the goat?)

Thanks for coming to my ted talk.

snippet.textDisplay:
My first Bon Jovi concert was Ostend 2000 just 2 month shy of turning 16.
My dad took me their as I became a fan in 98 when I saw a snippet of Born to be my baby in an mtv promo bought New Jersey and the entire backcatalog one CD at a time when I got my allowance haha
Sadly my dad passed away earlier this year and he always called me jovike..
I think the band doesn't know how they meant for alot of people.
I was bullied all thru high school and their music got me thru, there's a Bon Jovi song for every mood!

snippet.textDisplay: I've been a fan since Let Go. Back when I was 15, I created a website about Avril and punk rock music with some friends, and it quickly became one of the biggest of its kind in Europe for a few years (that was before the rise of FB), with a team of about 15 to 20 people collaborating from around the world. I saw Avril live in 2008 and got an autograph, and a few years later we collaborated quickly with Sony Music during the release of Goodbye Lullaby to help promote Goodbye Lullaby in France. Good and much better times. Listening to this now in 2025 is bringing back a lot of memories, and it's really great to see that Avril has remained such a great and smart artist.
